records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent RGBA foreground building sprite for a low-resolution 2D side scrolling game. The reference image is STYLE/PALETTE ONLY; the new warehouse must have a different silhouette.
Primary request: draw a compact abandoned warehouse with a walkable roof and a broad second-floor gallery above an open ground passage. This is a TWO STOREY building for a normal human, with LARGE HUMAN DOORS. Exact proportions: overall visible silhouette width 256 logical pixels, height 150 logical pixels; two human doors EACH 36 logical pixels high and 17 logical pixels wide, so each door is one quarter of the total building height. Do not make the warehouse more than 1.75 times wider than its height. Fill a square canvas with a compact building roughly centered, ample empty TRANSPARENT space above; do not squash it into a long thin banner.
Building layout: roof deck is 135 pixels above ground, second floor gallery deck 70 pixels above ground. Two broad square open drive-through arch bays at ground level, with no rear wall, genuine transparent empty space behind between thick concrete supports. Two floor-to-ceiling LARGE 36-pixel HUMAN DOORS open from the second-floor gallery into patched warehouse facade. One large broken industrial window, a heavy vent unit, thick service piping. Roof top is flat and clearly walkable. Gallery deck is flat and clearly walkable. Short loading rain canopy at right, exterior staircase at left is optional, no elaborate extra wings.
Style: deliberately chunky low-resolution clustered pixel art on a native 256×256 grid, no antialiasing, hard pixel edges; enlarged nearest-neighbor pixel game sprite. Strict straight-on orthographic SIDE elevation with NO perspective, no isometric, no visible floor plane.
Colors: match the reference's muted charcoal steel, warm gray-brown concrete, restrained rust ochre. Dim tiny amber lamps are acceptable. Moderate dark building values, readable but not high saturation. No blue wash, no bright cyan.
Constraints: entire coherent asset uncut, one level ground baseline. TRUE transparent alpha background and open passages. No sky, no background, no ground or sand, no floor plane, no cast shadow outside object. No human, character, vehicle, text, letters, labels, logo, watermark, guides, fog, haze, bloom, or excessive glow. Railing is sparse so the clear deck top lips can be matched with collision. Do not miniaturize doors. Do not copy reference facade.
records.notes: Accepted compact warehouse silhouette; true-alpha original. Root normalizes native grid, palette and collision independently.

records.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent RGBA 2D side-scrolling pixel-art game building sprite for the Nightwalker industrial battlefield.
Input images: image 1 gatehouse and image 2 tower are palette, low-resolution pixel density and side-elevation references ONLY; create a visibly different refinery building, not a tower copy.
Primary request: a tall compact oil-refinery plant building cutout with 3 huge vertical industrial cylinders/tanks of different heights, thick interconnected piping and broad connected steel maintenance catwalks at different heights. Visible building proportions roughly square: 256 logical native pixels wide by 230 logical native pixels tall. Fit the complete silhouette in frame. All support bases align on one horizontal baseline. A 28-native-pixel-tall player uses these catwalks: human service doors are about 36 logical pixels tall and catwalk railings about 10 logical pixels high.
Subject details: tall weathered cylindrical storage vessels, one thicker central cylinder, one shorter vessel to the left and a chimney-like cylindrical vessel right; steel cross-braced supports and thick elbow pipes; strong wide horizontal walkable platform ledges at about 55, 115 and 185 logical pixels above the baseline, connected between tank structures, with a broad readable topmost roof/walkway. Visible worn bolts, broken railing sections, vents, one attached maintenance cabin with human-sized door at a platform, rust-streaked tank bands. Ground floor MUST have large completely open transparent passage spaces between support columns, so the hero can run beneath. Industrial maintenance stairs can appear at one side but do not obscure the broad flat deck lips.
Style and composition: crisp deliberately low-resolution clustered pixel art on a 256×256 logical grid, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels; hard integer pixel edges, straight-on pure orthographic SIDE elevation. No visible ground plane and no isometric/perspective roof.
Palette/value: match reference dark charcoal steel, subdued warm gray and gray-brown concrete, restrained ochre rust. Very few dim amber lamp pixels. Desaturated, dark but readable, not a blue-tinted night city. No saturated blue or cyan. No bloom or atmospheric lighting. Edges of walkable deck tops have narrow worn warm gray strips.
Constraints: one complete cutout facility, TRUE transparent alpha background and through-holes, no black backdrop, no painted checkerboard. No sky, ground, sand, people, character, vehicles, scenery, fog, glow, outer cast shadow, floor shadow, writing, text, logos, watermarks, guides, or labels. Every platform stays flat and horizontal. Avoid miniature tiny human doors.
records.notes: Accepted three-vessel refinery; human maintenance access panel can be retained as small equipment door, larger human door patch recommended if gameplay uses it.
